results.name: portraits_00
results.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production game portrait texture atlas. Edit the provided original 4-column by 4-row sprite atlas into high-resolution crisp 1990s Japanese anime cel artwork. Canvas and placement are an exact registration contract: preserve the entire 4 by 4 grid, every portrait's bounding box, spacing, transparent gutters, head angle, expression, age, face proportions, eyes, hair, uniform and original colors. Each portrait is independent; never merge cells or invent an extra person. Replace pixel stair steps with smooth detailed ink lines and smooth flat cel-shaded colors. Do not zoom, recenter, resize or move any portrait or facial feature. Keep original white patches inside each portrait behind the head, and true alpha transparency everywhere originally transparent, including gutters. No labels, text, watermark, extra border or scenery. Output 2048 by 1792, exact same 8:7 canvas shape. The 16 small paintings should retain each character's distinctive anime design and remain recognizable at game size. Do not make the faces look like a common generic face. Any robot/animal/device portrait in a cell must remain that same robot/animal/device.
